domain_setting: A bright orchard stand and produce market with ripe fruit, fresh leaves, small ceramic bowls, and simple wooden displays. Show fruit cleanly, with cut sections when they reveal a defining interior.
recurring_scale_anchors: 304x192 card with essential content inside x=24..280 and y=16..176
Use ripe whole fruit with a cut half when the inside is a useful recognition cue
Use small clusters, leaves, pits, seeds, rind, and skin texture to distinguish related fruit
Use ceramic dishes or simple wooden market surfaces sparingly
No lettering, labels, numbers, brands, or decorative text

polysemy_resolution_table.mandarin: A mandarin orange fruit in this citrus lesson, not a Chinese official.
polysemy_resolution_table.lime: The small green citrus fruit, not mineral lime.
polysemy_resolution_table.currant: A dried small seedless grape (Zante currant), following the supplied Japanese gloss; do not repeat the fresh redcurrant or blackcurrant images.
polysemy_resolution_table.date: The edible date fruit in this dried-fruit group, not a calendar date.
polysemy_resolution_table.sultana: A small seedless dried grape, following the dried-fruit group; the supplied Japanese gloss describes an unrelated royal title.
polysemy_resolution_table.nuts: Edible nuts as a food category, not the informal adjective meaning crazy.
polysemy_resolution_table.fruit: Fruit as a general food category, represented by a small varied assortment rather than one specific fruit.

contrast_notes.lemon / lime / orange / mandarin / grape: Keep the citrus forms and colors distinct; use a cut cross-section to show their different pulp and size.
contrast_notes.blackberries / blackcurrants / blueberri: Use deep clustered blackberries, small dark currants, larger blue berries, tiny dried currants, and translucent red currants as distinct forms.
contrast_notes.peach / nectarine / apricot / plum: Show peach fuzz, smooth nectarine skin, smaller apricot flesh, and the plum's deep violet skin.
contrast_notes.raisin / golden raisin / sultana / curra: Raisin is dark dried grape; golden raisin is a bowl of plump amber raisins; sultana is a small joined cluster of pale golden seedless dried grapes; currants are tiny dark dried grapes.
contrast_notes.kiwi fruit / passion fruit / watermelon: Show the green seeded kiwi cross-section, the yellow seed-filled passion fruit interior, and the red seeded watermelon wedge with its striped green whole melon.
